an6.40:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimmilāyaṃ 1 viharati veḷuvane.
an6.40:1.3: atha kho āyasmā kimmilo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā kimmilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.40:1.4: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti
an6.40:1.5: idha kimmila tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari agāravā viharanti appatissā dhamme agāravā viharanti appatissā saṅghe agāravā viharanti appatissā sikkhāya agāravā viharanti appatissā appamāde agāravā viharanti appatissā paṭisanthāre agāravā viharanti appatissā
an6.40:1.6: ayaṃ kho kimmila hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
an6.40:2.1: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti
an6.40:2.2: idha kimmila tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari sagāravā viharanti sappatissā dhamme sagāravā viharanti sappatissā saṅghe sagāravā viharanti sappatissā sikkhāya sagāravā viharanti sappatissā appamāde sagāravā viharanti sappatissā paṭisanthāre sagāravā viharanti sappatissā
an6.40:2.3: ayaṃ kho kimmila hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
